text: Elementary, Intermediate and Advanced Classes are offered over summer vacation.Placement is done in accordance to the students' levels of Chinese.Each class is set up with as few students as possible for the purpose of accelerating the students' Chinese studies within a short term. The 6 weeks program is from July.16-Aug.24 . Students can choose 2-6 weeks of the program . According to students' Chinese proficiency , the program will divide into different levels of classes . The tuition fee is 500 RMB / week.
